action.objective: Recapture on f3 with the g2 pawn, restoring material balance after exf3
action.rationale: g2f3 is commit_ready: verified at effective depth 4 with score -213 exact-bound, safety.complete (no forced mate, no tactical refutation), and no stronger evidence against it. g5f3 is only -259 at depth 2 with bound exact but no safety verification, so g2f3 is preferred. The g4 bishop will have to retreat, and material stays balanced.
